brief: Squat early brick silo, about 14 ft across and only 22 ft high, of dark common brick in running bond, capped by a steep gable-roofed timber canopy with a plank-sheathed gable, the whole braced by an outside frame of heavy timber posts, rails and diagonal braces. It stands tight against the long side of the barn; in the example a later, much taller concrete stave silo rises behind it. Here the brick silo is the farm's only silo, a relic of an early silage experiment on a wheat farm.
